name: anim_jyu_sway_true
subject: a huge, heavy bear man made of glossy brown paint with messy cream splotches and a big round belly
desc: Loop: facing straight toward the viewer with both hands on his hips. His head stays perfectly upright and facing forward the whole time: it may ride along with the shoulders a little, but it never tilts, turns or nods, and he keeps staring straight down at the viewer with the same heavy, smug, leering gaze. Only the neck and everything below it moves: he lewdly grinds his hips in a very slow, heavy, sticky circle, rolling them far out to his left and lingering there, sinking lower with a small extra push, then dragging them slowly through the center and far out to his right where he lingers and sinks again, then back to the center. The knees bend deeply at each side and the body rises in the middle, and the big belly and chest lag behind the hips and sag and wobble heavily like thick, gooey liquid. Every motion is extremely slow, smooth and syrupy, easing in and out. The face keeps exactly the same eyebrows, nose, closed mouth and half-lidded eyes. Thick, sticky, viscous paint.
